requirements.label: GitHub Copilot / Claude Code
requirements.definition: Use an AI coding assistant to generate or edit code within a development workflow.
requirements.exclusions: Integrating a hosted model into an application does not establish use of a coding assistant.
requirements.context: Master AI-assisted coding workflows using GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Cursor. Build expertise in validating AI-generated code for security, correctness, and performance.

requirements.label: Prompt Engineering for Code
requirements.definition: Design and refine prompts specifically for generating, reviewing or debugging code.
requirements.exclusions: General API integration, ordinary coding, or non-code prompts do not establish code prompting.
requirements.context: Master AI-assisted coding workflows using GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Cursor. Build expertise in validating AI-generated code for security, correctness, and performance.

requirements.label: Security Code Review
requirements.definition: Review source code for vulnerabilities or apply security-specific checks and remediation.
requirements.exclusions: General code quality review or the adjective secure alone is insufficient.
requirements.context: Master AI-assisted coding workflows using GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Cursor. Build expertise in validating AI-generated code for security, correctness, and performance.

requirements.label: Python ML Libraries
requirements.definition: Apply Python machine learning libraries to training, evaluating or using ML models.
requirements.exclusions: JavaScript development or calls to hosted AI APIs alone are insufficient.
requirements.context: Build ML-integrated applications, design inference pipelines, and deploy models to production using cloud ML platforms and MLOps tools.

requirements.label: Model APIs (Vertex AI, Bedrock)
requirements.definition: Integrate hosted machine learning model APIs into an application. Listed platforms are examples, not mandatory vendors.
requirements.exclusions: Ordinary REST APIs, database APIs or general cloud deployment alone are insufficient.
requirements.context: Build ML-integrated applications, design inference pipelines, and deploy models to production using cloud ML platforms and MLOps tools.

requirements.label: MLOps Fundamentals
requirements.definition: Apply practices for model deployment, versioning, monitoring, evaluation or reproducible ML pipelines.
requirements.exclusions: Ordinary web CI/CD, Docker or model API consumption alone does not establish MLOps.
requirements.context: Build ML-integrated applications, design inference pipelines, and deploy models to production using cloud ML platforms and MLOps tools.

requirements.label: Product Discovery
requirements.definition: Investigate customer problems and validate product opportunities through discovery research or experiments.
requirements.exclusions: Implementing a specified feature or managing assigned development tasks alone is insufficient.
requirements.context: Transition from dev to PM for AI-powered products. Learn product discovery, user research, and roadmapping specific to AI feature development.

requirements.label: User Research
requirements.definition: Conduct user interviews, usability studies or other systematic research into user needs and behavior.
requirements.exclusions: Implementing Figma designs or describing work as UI/UX alone does not establish research.
requirements.context: Transition from dev to PM for AI-powered products. Learn product discovery, user research, and roadmapping specific to AI feature development.

requirements.label: AI Feature Roadmapping
requirements.definition: Prioritize and sequence AI product features using goals, dependencies, customer evidence and delivery constraints.
requirements.exclusions: Building an AI feature or coordinating a migration alone is insufficient.
requirements.context: Transition from dev to PM for AI-powered products. Learn product discovery, user research, and roadmapping specific to AI feature development.

requirements.label: Prompt Injection Testing
requirements.definition: Test AI systems with adversarial instructions to identify prompt injection vulnerabilities.
requirements.exclusions: Ordinary prompting, AI integration or application security alone is insufficient.
requirements.context: Apply software engineering skills to AI safety: build safety evaluation frameworks, conduct adversarial testing (jailbreaking, prompt injection), and implement safety guardrails.

requirements.label: Safety Eval Frameworks
requirements.definition: Build or apply structured evaluations of AI safety behavior and guardrails.
requirements.exclusions: General software unit tests or ordinary model accuracy evaluation alone are insufficient.
requirements.context: Apply software engineering skills to AI safety: build safety evaluation frameworks, conduct adversarial testing (jailbreaking, prompt injection), and implement safety guardrails.
